rationale: Re-distributing SACinhib synapses asymmetrically across PD-side and ND-side dendrites in RGCmodel.hoc is a fix to the deposited Poleg-Polsky lineage. The brainstorm session 9 decision is to build asymmetric inhibition into a from-scratch minimal DSGC (t0053) rather than retrofit the deposited code. Keep at medium priority for completeness if the deposited lineage is ever revived.
